regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood is forecast for about 59", 31" of it Wednesday. Palisades and Sugar Bowl follow. The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Kirkwood Wednesday and Wednesday night. Winter Storm Watch at Kirkwood from Tuesday night to Friday.

regions.title: Eastern Sierra
regions.text: Mammoth is forecast for about 42". The National Weather Service has heavy snow at Mammoth Wednesday and Wednesday night. The NWS is calling for more at Mammoth: 46 to 69 inches Monday through Thursday night. Winter Storm Warning at Mammoth from Wednesday to Friday.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Snowbird is forecast for about 16", 9" of it Tuesday. Alta and Snowbasin follow. The NWS is calling for more at Snowbird: 22 to 45 inches Tuesday through Friday night.

regions.title: Northern Rockies
regions.text: Grand Targhee is forecast for about 11", 8" of it Tuesday. Big Sky and Jackson Hole follow. The NWS is calling for more at Grand Targhee: 12 to 25 inches Tuesday through Friday night.

regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride is forecast for about 9". Crested Butte and Steamboat follow. The NWS is calling for more at Telluride: 8 to 15 inches Tuesday through Friday.

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek is forecast for about 9", 5" of it Friday. Taos follows. The NWS is calling for more at Wolf Creek: 17 to 33 inches Tuesday through Friday night.
